title: Identity across physical touchpoints
slide_intent: Compare an identity across physical scales so its recurring elements remain recognizable from a package to a vehicle or sign.
strategic_value: The X and broad color range can connect Xfinity’s mailed, delivered and street-level encounters.
demonstration: A short montage shows pink remote packaging, a blue mail piece, a row of differently colored vans and an orange projecting store sign.
practical_value: Check which identifiers survive changes in material, viewing distance and object shape before extending the system.

content_islands.name: Package and mail
content_islands.spec: Show close views of the pink package sleeve and blue addressed mail piece with white brand identifiers.

content_islands.name: Vehicle lineup
content_islands.spec: Present the colored vans together so the repeated large X can be compared across hues.

content_islands.name: Store sign
content_islands.spec: Finish with the projecting orange sign and dimensional white X against the dark facade.

ingredient.name: X across physical applications
ingredient.role: Identify related encounters despite changes in color, scale and material.
ingredient.application: Retain a prominent X or wordmark while adapting the color field to the package, mail piece, vehicle or sign.
ingredient.scope: Examples in the agency montage, not manufacturing specifications or a required color assignment for each medium.

reference_purposes.Intent: The accompanying case study describes rolling the identity across physical and digital touchpoints to connect the company’s expression.
reference_purposes.Expression: Bright single-color fields and white identifiers recur on packages, mail, vans and signage.
reference_purposes.Application: The montage demonstrates the identity on four different physical touchpoints.
